name: Hotel Prabhat Vihar Restaurant
why_it_matters: JTDC-run restaurant inside Hotel Prabhat Vihar — effectively the only sit-down dining in Netarhat. Open to non-residents but kitchen is small, so meals must be ordered well in advance. Litti-chokha is the property's house dish.
insider_tip: Order food 2-3 hours ahead — service is slow and stocks run out by evening. Carry packed snacks for sunrise/sunset point treks; nothing else opens early.
signature_address: Hotel Prabhat Vihar Deluxe, Netarhat, Latehar District 829204
